shadows.purpose: Dialogs, sheets, and genuinely floating controls only.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: App-bar Files route and no persistent bottom navigation.

breakpoints.name: expanded
breakpoints.purpose: Material navigation rail and recomposed layout.

narrative.overview: A calm, precise Android utility that makes local sharing feel immediate and trustworthy. Material 3 governs structure; Vidyut expresses itself through disciplined raspberry color, Manrope typography, geometric softness, tonal depth, and purposeful motion.

rules.name: The Signal Clarity Rule
rules.body: Important state is never communicated through color alone.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Manrope is the only product typeface.

dos: Use shared tokens and state-aware primitives.
Design light and dark states together.
Honor text scaling and reduced motion.
donts: Do not add a persistent compact-phone bottom bar.
Do not make every surface a large rounded card.
Do not add undocumented visual values.
